reason: Authorized diagnosis of validation score shift, discrimination and threshold recurrence; no training or test.

data.evaluation_scope: historical validation only; no September or October evaluation

record.decision: B12 last-fold scores narrow and all maxima stay below .70; seed43 also has weak ranking (AUC .4642) while seeds42/44 retain top-tail discrimination. B11 last-fold degrades across all seeds; other barriers do not uniformly degrade. B12 all-three-seed recurrence with >=30 signals is 15/38 at .575/60%, 2/38 at .705/65%, 0/38 at .755/70%. Keep final test closed pending a justified model/policy; no automatic retraining.
limitations: Same validation used for epoch choice and diagnostics; optimistic.
Overlapping windows, labels and seeds are not independent; no confidence intervals or significance claim.
No raw-feature or checkpoint analysis; causal explanation not established.
High precision with small support is not acceptance evidence.
AP/BCE compare different targets across barriers; no automatic winner.

method.analysis: score distributions, AP/prevalence, ROC AUC, BCE skill, top102 ranking, seed rank agreement, fixed-threshold recurrence

record.question: Son dönemde sinyal kaybı puan ölçeğinden mi, ayırt etme kaybından mı; yüksek precision dönemlerde tekrarlanıyor mu?
record.selection_rule: No model/threshold selected. Previously discussed thresholds only. Support sensitivity is descriptive, not a new acceptance constraint. Top102 ranking is retrospective diagnostic, not a live strategy.
